name: Content Trend Analyzer
description: Collects signals, classifies trends, extracts tensions, and generates content angles.

nodes.label: Analysis Trigger
nodes.description: Accepts a topic or domain as input.

nodes.label: Signal Collector
nodes.description: Fetches recent signals from RSS feeds, social platforms, and search trends.

nodes.label: Scoring Module
nodes.description: Scores each signal by recency, volume, and source authority.

nodes.label: Trend Classifier
nodes.description: Classifies signals into emerging, established, or declining trend categories.

nodes.label: Tension Extractor
nodes.description: Identifies tensions, debates, and unresolved questions within the trend landscape.

nodes.label: Angle Generator
nodes.description: Generates actionable content angles from classified trends and extracted tensions.

nodes.label: Trend Report
nodes.description: The final trend report with classified trends and content angles.
